description.en:
Crop Calendar Sort is a Farming Simulator 25 quality-of-life mod that adds selectable ordering modes to the standard in-game crop calendar.
Open the normal crop calendar and use the SORT menu action to choose how its rows are ordered.
Sort modes: - Native Order: restores the order supplied by the game/map. - Alphabetical A-Z: sorts every calendar entry by its displayed/localised crop name. - Plantable A-Z: puts crops which allow seeding first, alphabetically, followed by the remaining entries alphabetically. - Planting Start: sorts by the first planting period, with A-Z as the tie-breaker. - Harvest Start: sorts by the first harvest period, with A-Z as the tie-breaker. - Plant Now: puts crops plantable in the current seasonal period first, A-Z within each group. - Harvest Now: puts crops harvestable in the current seasonal period first, A-Z within each group. - Next Planting: sorts by the nearest planting opportunity from the current period, wrapping through the year. - Next Harvest: sorts by the nearest harvest opportunity from the current period, wrapping through the year.
The selected mode is stored as a player preference under modSettings and applies across savegames.
The mod changes only the presentation order of the native crop calendar. It does not modify crop definitions, planting windows, growth states, fields, contracts or savegame data.
Version 0.3.0.0: - Added Plant Now and Harvest Now gameplay-focused sort modes. - Added Next Planting and Next Harvest rolling seasonal sort modes. - Current-period modes use the active FS25 seasonal period and safely fall back to A-Z if it cannot be resolved. - Retained Native, A-Z, Plantable A-Z, Planting Start and Harvest Start modes. - Uses the stock FS25 OptionDialog directly. - Persistent player preference storage remains enabled.
